entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi. I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
VF58921-PULSE. It's just not working for me.

Okay, I'm pulling up the order now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered twelve days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I just find it really hard to use. The whole menu system is confusing, and frankly, I expected more for what it cost.
I understand. Did you have a chance to review the user manual? It has a few walkthroughs of the more advanced features.
Yeah, I looked at the user manual. It didn't help. Look, can I return it or not?
Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility for this item. Please hold one moment.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return immediately.
I'm generating a prepaid return label for you, which I'll send to the email address on file. You can just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.

Yes, once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. You should receive the confirmation email with the label in the next few minutes. Is there anything else?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
